name: Powder Snow ~Kono Basho de Issho ni~
original_name: POWDER SNOW ～この場所で一緒に～
source:
Main character used to be a great warrior, but constant fight with evil eroded his flesh with only two weeks remaining to live. He is given a girl caretaker by his relatives to have some comfort at least in the end in his life.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-december-2000-never7-end-of.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角曾是一名偉大的戰士，但長年與邪惡勢力交戰，早已拖垮了他的身體，只剩兩週可活。為了讓他在生命的最後時光裡至少得到些許慰藉，親屬們為他安排了一名少女照料起居。

[出自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-december-2000-never7-end-of.html]vndbreview[/url]]
